scope: K0909 worker memo merge algebra and the bound-retention comparison used by the boundary-preserving 4-worker measurement

execution.method: The two GitHub source files were copied byte-for-byte to /tmp; git hash-object matched both recorded Git blob SHAs before execution. The updated unittest module was then run with PYTHONPATH=/tmp.

assertions: max_bound is commutative, idempotent, matches the finite-max-with-255-identity reference, and is associative over all 256^3 triples
255 is the identity for every finite negative bound 0..254
bound_at_least matches the absence-aware reference over all 256^2 value/required pairs
cross-worker win/nowin and lose/nolose contradictions remain detectable
weaker finite negative bounds survive merging without false conflicts
the published verbatim all-255 negative-bound records retain their prior merged values

interpretation.note: This validates the sentinel algebra and comparison helper only. It does not rerun the large 4-worker measurement or the 11x11 game search.
